q: Will switching our Howrah foundry from cupola to induction furnace cut CO2?
title: Howrah foundry: cupola to induction
short: Not automatically on grid power. An induction furnace replaces coke with electricity, and at India's grid factor of 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh the CO2 per tonne can land close to a well-run cupola. It falls clearly when the power comes from solar or other renewable supply, and local smoke drops either way.
audience: Cast iron foundries in Howrah considering induction melting

sections.h: Compare per tonne of molten metal
ul: Cupola: tonnes of coke per tonne of metal times about 3.0 t CO2.
Induction: kWh per tonne of metal times 0.710, from your trials or the supplier's guarantee.
Renewable power through open access or rooftop solar.
Yield and melt loss in each route.
Holding time: induction furnaces left on between heats waste power.

p: Measure your cupola's actual coke ratio for a month. Many foundries find it higher than they assumed.

example.title: Illustrative only, replace with your own figures
lines: Cupola at 0.12 t coke per t metal: 0.12 x 3.0 = 0.36 t CO2/t
Induction at 600 kWh per t metal: 600 x 0.710 = 0.43 t CO2/t
